I have farmed this small piece for many years, and last season I put manure from my goats on it because a full bag of shop fertilizer is too much money for only 0.11 hectares. I will plant the local seed I kept from last harvest since it grows without fertilizer, and my daughter and I will do all the weeding and harvesting ourselves because I have no cash to pay anyone. I do not spray chemicals and I cannot irrigate — I wait for the rains like everyone else.
